change: Official Qualcomm Qwen3-0.6B W4A16 mixed-precision compiled artifact through native GenieX QAIRT, instead of the GGUF Q4_0 llama.cpp deployment. No grammar, routing, speculation or prompt changes. This is a deployment comparison, not a same-weights kernel speedup.
expected_improvement: Test native NPU task latency and full-process SYS energy while preserving all correctness failures. No improvement is presumed.
